Da-dun-daaah! ♪ Da-dun! Da-dun!
Dun-dah,
dun-dadaaah... Boom!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Come on! This is where you call my
name! El
Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You know, like a pro wrestler's entrance!
Come
on, Trainer, do it!

text_block_list.text:
I bet if we did it before a race, the
crowd would
get super hyped! Right?
Right? Come on, let's do
iiit!
